title: Implants modulating gene expression through bioelectricity

tellings.quote: maybe these things are are modulating some sort of gene expression to to make the beings into what they are.

plain: Implants found in the three-fingered bodies from Nazca, Peru, which some say may not be human, might be using electrical signals to control the bodies' genes, "to make the beings into what they are." The researcher Allan Ezarus offers this idea to Michels as his own guess, with no source. If it were true, the implants would be what shaped the beings' bodies.
